scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build && ssh pi4 'sudo rm -rf /tmp/sg-admin-tmp && mkdir -p /tmp/sg-admin-tmp' && scp -r dist/. pi4:/tmp/sg-admin-tmp/ && scp ../scripts/splitgate-admin.py pi4:/tmp/sg-admin-py.tmp && ssh pi4 'sudo cp -r /tmp/sg-admin-tmp/. /etc/splitgate/admin/ && sudo rm -rf /tmp/sg-admin-tmp && sudo chown -R root:root /etc/splitgate/admin && sudo mv /tmp/sg-admin-py.tmp /usr/local/bin/splitgate-admin && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/splitgate-admin && sudo systemctl restart splitgate-admin.service && echo DONE'
